statements.t: As previously announced, the Company has entered into a definitive merger agreement pursuant to which it will be acquired by Clayton, Dubilier & Rice, LLC and McKesson Corporation.
Given the pending acquisition, the Company will not host an earnings conference call in connection with these results and has withdrawn its previously disclosed financial guidance.

Instead, they are based only on the Company's current beliefs, expectations and assumptions regarding the future of its business, future plans and strategies, projections, anticipated events and trends, the economy and other future conditions.

The Company has not reconciled Adjusted EBITDA guidance to net income or Adjusted diluted EPS guidance to GAAP diluted EPS as management believes creation of this reconciliation would not be practicable due to the uncertainty regarding, and potential variability of, material reconciling items.
Management continues to expect CID-related dynamics to negatively impact gross profit by approximately $55 million during 2026.
